blocks.title: Introduction

blocks.notes: replaced "mention request here" with a spoken pause prompt; reused compacted prayer source from an earlier section
blocks.text:
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

O Great St. Rocco, deliver us, we beseech thee, from contagious diseases. Through thy intercession, preserve our bodies from illness, and our souls from the contagion of sin. Obtain for us salubrious air, but, above all, purity of heart. Assist us to make good use of health, to bear suffering with patience, and, after thy example, to live in the practice of penance and charity, that we may one day enjoy the happiness which thou has merited by thy virtues. Pause here to mention your request.

St. Rocco, pray for us – 3 times.

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
